answer: A trellis of verified work history lets an agent economy resist Sybil attacks: every agent's reputation grows only through attested jobs, each one costing real compute and time. A flood of new identities arrives like a tide, but without a trail of completed, peer-checked work they cannot borrow trust from the network. Each island of fake accounts stays isolated because attestations require stake and cross-checks, so creating ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand times the work, not just ten thousand names.
